Keep both hands empty, separated from the straps and threaded only at their wrist pass-throughs. Preserve canvas, family materials, cold light, scale and full silhouette clearance. No floor/contact shadow, room, wall, body, face, key, weapon, branch, waist cord, second rope, third hanger, scene, text, logo or watermark. Opaque near-black studio.
